findings.observation: Канонические таблицы документируют ChEMBL как 3 req/sec, включая ложную ссылку на chembl.yaml; живой конфиг задаёт 0.1 rps / burst 1.
findings.method: Compare README/RULES/specs/welcome page against configs/providers/chembl.yaml and docs/03-guides/pipeline-configuration.md rate table.
findings.expected: Published rate tables match configs/providers/{provider}.yaml (RULES Appendix A: yaml is canonical).
findings.actual: chembl.yaml requests_per_second=0.1 burst=1; README:83, RULES.md:1851, docs/00-project/index.md:111 (Last verified 2026-08-21), docs/04-reference/pipelines/chembl/05-activity-spec.md:30 ('3 req/sec (configs/providers/chembl.yaml)'), docs/04-reference/pipelines/README.md:96, docs/02-architecture/03-infrastructure-layer.md:137 still say 3 req/sec. pipeline-configuration.md:709 already lists 0.1.
findings.impact: Operators and capacity planning use a 30x-wrong public rate; a 'docs-aligned' yaml edit would hammer ChEMBL. Spec falsely cites the yaml.
findings.root_cause: Stale provider tables copied across README/RULES/specs after yaml was tightened; no automated docs↔yaml rate check.
findings.remediation: Replace 3 req/sec with 0.1 req/sec (burst 1) everywhere, or label 3 as upstream API courtesy and yaml as runtime cap. Add a check that published tables parse yaml.
validation: rg -n '3 req/sec' README.md docs/00-project/RULES.md docs/04-reference/pipelines docs/00-project/index.md
findings.automation: Extend scripts.docs check-links --configs or a provider-rate table test.

evidence.observation: Correct table row: ChEMBL 0.1 req/sec burst 1

findings.observation: Getting Started утверждает, что raw uv sync extras — это реализация make install, но extras другие; Windows fallback создаёт venv через py -3.13 при baseline 3.12; verify гоняет run-tests cov без tests_full.
findings.method: Diff getting-started.md sections 2.1/2.3/4 against Makefile install target and README Option A notes.
findings.expected: Onboarding commands match Makefile/README extras and Python 3.12 baseline; verify lane extras cover architecture/cov.
findings.actual: getting-started.md:133-135 claims raw uv sync is the implementation of make install. Makefile:99 is uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tests_full --extra export. getting-started 2.3 uses --extra dev --extra tests --extra tracing (no tests_full/export). Windows fallback line 127 is py -3.13 -m venv .venv-win. Section 4 runs run-tests cov which includes tests/architecture and --cov-fail-under=85. README:172 already documents the extras split.
findings.impact: Clean-checkout users following Getting Started can miss tests_full (arch/benchmark extras) and fail cov/arch, or fail venv create if only Python 3.12 is installed.
findings.root_cause: Guide copied README Option A extras and labeled them as make install.
findings.remediation: Quote Makefile extras for make install; keep tracing as a documented delta; change py -3.13 to py -3.12 (or py -3.12+); tell cov/arch users to add tests_full.
findings.automation: Docs test that getting-started extras match Makefile install or an explicit delta table.

evidence.observation: Raw `uv sync --extra …` is the implementation of `make install` only.
uv sync --extra dev --extra tests --extra tests_full --extra export
